mapper.select: SELECT * FROM posts WHERE deleted = false ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT * FROM posts WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = false
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (title, author, password, content, view_count, created_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{author}, #{password}, #{content}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND password = #{password} AND deleted = false
UPDATE posts SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = false
UPDATE posts SET deleted = true WHERE id = #{id}
